findings.text: The selftest runs longer (dominated by the real pty subprocess drives); a gate-latency observation, not a defect.

Several renderer branches listed in AC1 (relative cursor moves, backspace, tab, bright colors, additional erase/scroll modes) are implemented and exercised indirectly but not each individually asserted; extending the unit block would harden the reference but is not required for correctness.

summary: B19 (WARP-0319, terminal/TUI reference runner) is correct and honest. Independent adversarial review: clean PASS, gate GREEN, both fixtures correct (pass exit 0; fail exit 1 naming the dropped-bold cell at (2,4)/(2,6), a defect a raw-byte grep for the text would miss), 8/8 mutations caught, 7 rubber-stamp cases plus a forced pty-absent path all rejected as named errors, capabilities mechanical honest (renderer plus real pty both run in the gate; live drive fails loud without pty), generic, ASCII, no double-hyphen, stdlib-only, both capabilities.yaml copies byte-identical. Landed unchanged from review. proof_digest recomputed via validate.py.
